name: anatomix-t1w-dwi-registration
desc: Registers a DWI series onto a T1w anatomical image with anatomix (modality-agnostic deep features) + FireANTs (GPU-accelerated diffeomorphic registration). The b0 volume is extracted internally from the DWI series (mean of low-b volumes) and used as the moving image; the T1w image is the fixed/reference space.

b0_max_bval.desc: b-value (s/mm^2) at or below which a DWI volume is treated as a b0 and averaged to build the moving image.

transform.desc: Comma-separated registration stages, in order, from rigid/affine/deformable (see anatomix-register.py --help). Must end in a deformable stage: this app's warp output is a NIfTI displacement field, which anatomix-register.py only writes when the last stage is deformable. affine,deformable handles gross T1w/DWI misalignment plus local distortion; use deformable alone if the images are already roughly aligned.

save_inverse.desc: Also compute the moving-to-fixed (DWI/b0 -> T1w) inverse transform, e.g. to bring a T1w-space parcellation into native DWI space for tractography ROIs.

device.desc: Compute device for FireANTs: auto, cpu, cuda, or cuda:N.

outputs.desc: Mean b0 volume extracted from the DWI series, registered (resampled) onto the T1w grid.

FireANTs transform (ITK/ANTs LPS-mm displacement field convention, not FSL) that resamples the DWI/b0 (moving) image onto T1w (fixed) space -- apply it to other DWI-space volumes (e.g. FA, MD maps) to bring them into T1w space. With save_inverse enabled, inverse-warp.nii.gz does the reverse (T1w -> native DWI space).
